visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a silver fork and knife slicing through a thick, juicy steak covered in a dark, glossy black pepper sauce. Beneath the steak, white thick noodles and a small yellow baby corn are visible on a dark, sizzling cast-iron platter. The setting is a brightly lit restaurant with warm wooden tables. (2) A medium close-up shot transitions to show two slices of pizza on a grey plate featuring the brand logo '貴族世家 mini'. One slice has broccoli and corn, while the other appears to have ham and cheese. The background is a dimly lit dining area with a receipt visible on the table. (3) A clear shot of a menu board is shown, detailing 'Salad Bar Charge' prices based on height, with prices listed as NT$220 and NT$260. The menu is professional, with brand logos and illustrations of steaks on the side. (4) The camera pans across a stainless steel buffet bar containing various fresh fruits. Lemons and limes are cut into wedges, next to containers filled with purple dragon fruit and white guava. The lighting is bright and industrial, highlighting the freshness of the produce. (5) A series of quick cuts follows, showing a whole steak on a sizzling plate with green beans and carrots, and then hands using utensils to tear apart a piece of grilled chicken. The background remains the consistent wooden texture of the restaurant tables. (6) The view shifts to the snack section of the buffet, showcasing white bowls filled with fried sweet potato balls (purple and yellow) and golden-brown chicken nuggets. The lighting is warm and inviting. (7) A close-up shows a person's hand holding a slice of pizza, followed by shots of beverage dispensers and a soft-serve ice cream machine dispensing a white vanilla swirl into a wafer cone. (8) The camera captures the DIY noodle station where a metal strainer is used to blanch bean sprouts and noodles in hot water, then bowls of rice topped with curry and braised pork sauce are shown. (9) A male reviewer with glasses is seen in a close-up, eating noodles and later a slice of pizza. He is wearing a beige hoodie. The final shots show the store's exterior with a large yellow 'Noble Family' sign and a red address overlay on the screen.
